Order 
This first bail application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C is filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail, who is in custody since 7.10.2024 in connection with Crime No.189/2021 registered at Police Station & District Mauganj (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(1), 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the prosecutrix is major and there is no proper documentary evidence to show that she was minor at the time of the incident.
This is an admitted fact which is not disputed by learned Government Advocate for the State that Class-1 Marksheet/Dakhil Kharij Form is not available with the Government Advocate.
There are several contradictory stands taken by the State Government.

There is no other relevant proof of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:5800 2 MCRC-52670-2024 date of birth as is admissible under the provisions of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Taking all these facts into consideration and keeping in view the fact that there are good chances of success and there is no criminal antecedent of the present applicant, this bail application is allowed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant Mehandi Hasan be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court for his appearance before the said Court on the dates given by the concerned Court during pendency of trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective.
